description: This file contains error handling and exception reporting functions for the Nios II architecture in Zephyr OS, including fatal error handling, exception cause interpretation, and system halt routines.

methods.name: z_nios2_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles fatal errors for Nios II, logs register states if debugging is enabled, then calls system fatal error handler.

methods.name: _Fault
methods.description: Handles CPU exceptions, logs cause and address info if available, then invokes fatal error handler.

methods.name: arch_system_halt
methods.description: Halts the system for debugging purposes on ALT_CPU_HAS_DEBUG_STUB architectures.
